desc: The DPMS Oracle II 5.56 NATO is a rugged and reliable AR-style rifle chambered in 5.56mm, featuring a 16-inch barrel and a 30-round magazine capacity. Designed for durability and versatility, this carbine-length platform utilizes a PSA Classic Carbine stock and features a black finish over a steel frame, making it well-suited for tactical use, training, or recreational shooting.
